hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In my humble role as Betty Ryal, a maid at the grand mansion of Lord Corinth, I was sweeping the parlor floor. The room was dimly lit by the faint glow of an oil lamp, and the air was thick with the scent of pine and fresh soaps. As I moved, my steps echoed softly against the polished wood. I heard a soft, muffled sound behind me and turned just in time to see the reflection of two figures in a small mirror set into the door. One, a fair-haired maiden with eyes that seemed to dance, was tenderly embracing a gentleman with a dark beard. His arms were wrapped around her, and her hands were gently caressing his back. The room was suffused with a warm, intimate air, and I felt my heart quicken with curiosity.
caption:
Caught my new maid helping the gentleman in the inn's scullery! 😍
